findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_offers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The three things Beacon sells (AI answer audit, visibility monitoring, enterprise and agency builds), who each is for and what is included. No prices: every engagement is quoted." → after: "The three things Beacon sells (AI answer audit, visibility monitoring, ChatGPT app and plugin builds), who each is for and what is included. No prices: every engagement is quoted."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
